> 第79章 声名鹊起（第1页）
医道大会结束后，秦川的名字以一种他从未预料过的方式在中界传播开来。
起初是百草谷的弟子们在向外写信时顺带提了一笔——“谷里来了个凡人，在医道大会上驳倒了天医宗的内门弟子，还跟少宗主喝了茶”。这类家书和同门通信在中界各宗门之间来回传递，很快引起了更多人的兴趣。有人开始专门打听这个凡人的来历，打听的过程本身就是一种传播——越是查不到底细，越是传得神。
临渊镇的说书人率先编了一折《青山猎户医道论剑》，在茶馆里连讲三天，场场爆满。说书人把秦川和柳少微的三局两胜改编成了“猎户以凡人之身舌?战群医”的传奇，把冷水退烧和酒浸寒水石的手法描绘得神乎其神。故事传到凌云宗时，周鹤年长老默默放下了手中的茶盏。他还记得那个站在劈柴汉子身后的凡人，也记得楚云霆从青山村回来后说的那一句“刑天殿不审英雄”。
消息传到青山村时，老陆正在劈柴。李神医拿着信走到村口，靠在老槐树下念给他听。老陆从头听到尾，没有停下手里的斧头。李神医念完后问他有什么看法，老陆劈完最后一块柴，将斧头放在石墩上，拿起碗喝了一口水：“他学会了劈最难劈的那块柴。”
钱不缺是最早知道的那一批。不是通过传言，而是在百草谷的眼线第一时间将闭幕宴的消息送回了诸天交易所。据说钱不缺听完报告后，在账本上秦川的名字下面加了一行注：“甲级客户的甲级，不是因为实力——是因为他总能让所有人都觉得赢了。”然后他合上账本，对他身边那位裹在黑袍里的助手说了一句：“我那枚铜板，差不多该收利息了。”
更让秦川意外的是，苏木槿几天后收到了百草谷外派弟子的飞剑传书。说有个自称“钱不缺的朋友”的客商，在临渊镇买了一栋临街铺面，说是要“替秦公子开一家凡人医馆”。铺面已经在装修，招牌已经刻好，叫“青山堂”。
苏木槿把这条消息转达给秦川时，表情很难形容——既像是在期待他的反应，又像是在观察他对钱不缺的评价。
“钱不缺是在给你的未来铺路。”她说，“他知道你不会永远待在百草谷，也知道你迟早需要一个独立于所有宗门之外的地方。他提前替你准备好了。”
“他不只是在铺路。”秦川看着窗外谷中层层叠叠的药田，“他是在告诉我——他相信我一定能走出去。他提前买好的不是铺面，是信任。那枚铜板的利息，不是钱。是我。”
苏木槿看着他的侧脸，没有再说话。
秦川将这份复杂的情绪暂且搁置，转身回到工作间，继续整理与天医宗合作外伤急救手册的协议框架。沈青黛在门外的药田边喊了他一声，说柳少微的通信玉简刚刚到了，问他第一稿的急救手法图解用什么颜色标注伤口。秦川拿起笔一边回答一边往外走，手上沾着墨迹，袖口卷到手肘。
声名鹊起。但他还是穿着那件洗得发灰的粗布短褐，袖口有劈柴磨出的线头，握笔的姿势和老陆握斧头的姿势越来越像。

> Chapter 79 Rising to Fame (Page 1)
After the medical conference, Qin Chuan's name spread in the middle world in a way that he had never expected.
At first, the disciples of Baicao Valley mentioned something in passing when they wrote to the outside world - "A mortal came from the valley, refuted the inner disciples of Tianyi Sect at the medical conference, and even drank tea with the young sect leader." Such family letters and correspondence from fellow sects were passed back and forth among the sects in the middle realm, quickly arousing the interest of more people. Someone began to specifically inquire about the origin of this mortal. The process of inquiry itself was a kind of communication - the less detailed it was, the better it was spread.
The storyteller from Linyuan Town took the lead in compiling a piece of "Qingshan Orion's Medical Theory of Sword" and lectured on it in the teahouse for three consecutive days, and the venue was full. The storyteller adapted Qin Chuan and Liu Shaowei's two-out-of-three games into the legend of "Orion used his mortal body to speak out against the group of doctors", and described the techniques of cold water to reduce fever and wine-soaked cold water stones as magical. When the story reached Lingyun Sect, Elder Zhou Henian silently put down the tea cup in his hand. He still remembered the mortal standing behind the man chopping firewood, and also remembered what Chu Yunting said after returning from Qingshan Village, "The Xingtian Palace does not judge heroes."
When the news reached Qingshan Village, Lao Lu was chopping firewood. Doctor Li took the letter and walked to the entrance of the village, leaning under the old locust tree and reading it to him. Lao Lu listened from beginning to end without stopping to hold the ax in his hand. After the doctor Li finished reading, he asked him what he thought. After Lao Lu finished splitting the last piece of firewood, he placed the ax on the stone pier, picked up the bowl and took a sip of water: "He learned to split the most difficult piece of firewood."
Qian Buqian was the first group to know. It was not through rumors, but the informants in Baicao Valley immediately sent the news of the closing banquet back to Zhutian Exchange. It is said that after Qian Buque listened to the report, he added a note under Qin Chuan's name on the account book: "The Grade A customer is not because of his strength - it is because he always makes everyone feel like he has won." Then he closed the account book and said to the assistant wrapped in a black robe beside him: "It's almost time to collect interest on my copper plate."
What surprised Qin Chuan even more was that a few days later, Su Mujin received a letter from a disciple sent from Baicao Valley. It was said that a businessman who claimed to be a "friend with no shortage of money" bought a street-facing shop in Linyuan Town, saying that he wanted to "open a mortal medical clinic for Mr. Qin." The shop is already being renovated, and the signboard has been engraved, called "Qingshan Hall".
When Su Mujin conveyed this news to Qin Chuan, her expression was hard to describe - as if she was expecting his reaction, but also as if she was observing his evaluation of the lack of money.
"The lack of money is paving the way for your future." She said, "He knows that you will not stay in Baicao Valley forever, and he also knows that sooner or later you will need a place that is independent of all sects. He has prepared it for you in advance."
"He is not just paving the road." Qin Chuan looked out the window at the stacks of medicinal fields in the valley. "He is telling me that he believes that I will be able to get out. What he bought in advance is not the pavement, but trust. The interest on that copper plate is not money. It is me."
Su Muxin looked at his profile and said nothing.
Qin Chuan put the complicated emotions aside for the time being, turned back to the workroom, and continued to organize the framework of the agreement on the trauma first aid manual for cooperation with the Heavenly Medicine Sect. Shen Qingdai called him from the medicine field outside the door, saying that Liu Shaowei's jade slip had just arrived, and asked him what color he used to mark the wounds in the first draft of the diagram of first aid techniques. Qin Chuan picked up the pen and answered while walking out, his hands stained with ink and his sleeves rolled up to his elbows.
